Last year G*C was held very close in time to the VTES North American
Championship (which had been held at GenCon in prior years, but was held on its
own in 2007). So GC2007 had the lowest turnout of VTES players that it had had
in at least seven years. I'd guess the number was around 50.

The 2008 NA Championship will likewise be held on its own, but isn't until
October. So the numbers at Gen*Con should be slightly higher than in 2007.
